obs.wave2.group115.pushforward-measure.0.context: Pushforward of a nonnegative measure through a measurable map of measurable spaces / preimage-evaluation-measure
obs.wave2.group115.pushforward-measure.0.editorial_note: ProofWiki defines pushforward of a measure μ on one measurable space along a Σ/Σ′-measurable map f by measuring inverse images of measurable target sets. The apparent arrow direction is important: source X to target Y but evaluation pulls sets backward before applying μ. Measurability ensures f^{-1}(B) lies in Σ, so the right side is defined; ordinary arbitrary set functions or nonmeasurable maps do not qualify. This is a new measure on the target measurable space, not image set f[X], and f_*μ is not literally composition with f, but composition μ∘f^{-1} acting on sets. The source shows extended-real codomain; the existing independent approved nonnegative measure meaning specifies [0,+∞], preserving positivity and infinity. It is distinct from pushforward of probability distributions only in generality; no normalization μ(X)=1 is assumed. Source sections: Definition, Also known as, Pushforward Measure is Measure cited
obs.wave2.group115.pushforward-measure.0.text: Let (X,Σ) and (Y,Τ) be measurable spaces, μ:Σ→[0,+∞] a measure, and f:X→Y a (Σ,Τ)-measurable map. The pushforward measure f_*μ on (Y,Τ) is defined for every B∈Τ by (f_*μ)(B)=μ(f⁻¹(B)).
